case: invalidate — an archive from before a save-format bump
why: §7.7's second rule and the worst available failure: Go-Explore archives persist ACROSS runs, so an entry written under SAVE_FILE_VERSION 2.0 outlives the upgrade. Restoring a stale-format snapshot that happens to parse produces a world that is subtly not the world the archive believed it had. Invalidated, never restored.

archive.note: A Go-Explore archive entry. TBP's save_checkpoint response carries {id, tier, frame, latency_ms, bytes, level} and no version field, so these axes are stamped by the adapter alongside the id.
